test_names: CONTAINED: kill + checkpoint resume yields IDENTICAL completion evidence to the uninterrupted run (continuity, not restart)
VISIBLE: the resume shows as continuity in the user-visible timeline (checkpoint + body-replaced events)
UNCERTAINTY RETAINED: the work program's uncertainty statement survives the resume (never dropped)
CONTAINED (fail-closed): a corrupted checkpoint is the typed CHECKPOINT_INVALID denial — never silently re-derived, never resumed from
CONTAINED (fail-closed): resume of an unrecorded checkpoint id is a typed refusal (durable checkpoints only)
terminal_state: CONTAINED: the resumed run completes with IDENTICAL verification evidence to the uninterrupted run; corrupted/unrecorded checkpoints fail closed with typed denials
detection_containment: the combined evidence (checkpointed prior + resumed segment) equals the uninterrupted run step-for-step; the completion records match on verified/evidence_refs/summary
the timeline shows continuity: checkpoint-category entries, recovery-category entries and the task.body-replaced event
checkpoint integrity: a tampered payload under a stored id fails verify (the original still verifies; an unknown id never verifies)
retained_uncertainty: the work program's uncertainty statement is executed and recorded during the resumed segment (outcome RECORDED)
notes: The suites ran twice at the verified head (identical results) and re-ran green at the delivery head (the evidence-only follow-up commit that fills verified_head_revision with the exact code-head sha and adds only these records).
